answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 47632 Country: India Title: EID PRAYERS FOR WOMEN Question: Though women have no need to offer Eid salah, is it fine for them if there is a facility for women to offer by jamah and there is no fitnah (privacy)? Answer ID: 47632 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1131/881/D=10/1434) The women were stopped from going to the mosque for Eid salah or five times salah in the era of Ameerul Momineen Umar bin al-Khattab (رضي الله عنه) due to the fear of fitnah and on the basis of some hadith indications. At present days, the condition is bad to worst; hence it is better to follow that ruling. Now there is no need to check where the fear of fitnah exists and where not. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
